description.en: Dissolves your live HTML below a chosen line into fine sand particles that reassemble on scroll.
description.zh: 将指定分界线下方的实时 HTML 化为细沙粒子，并随滚动重新聚合。

discovery.caveat: 涉及实时 HTML 捕获；适合局部叙事段落，浏览器要求见详情。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: Viewport fraction of the formation line. Content assembles as it scrolls up past this line and dissolves back below it.
description.zh: 成形线在视口中的比例位置；内容向上滚过此线时聚合，回到下方时重新溶解。

description.en: Height in CSS pixels of the transition band where particles progressively reassemble.
description.zh: 粒子逐渐重新聚合的过渡带高度，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: Grain spacing in CSS pixels. Smaller values mean finer, denser sand.
description.zh: 颗粒间距，单位为 CSS 像素；值越小沙粒越细密。

description.en: Size of fully scattered dust grains in CSS pixels. Grains grow to cover their cell as they land.
description.zh: 完全散开时的尘埃颗粒尺寸，单位为 CSS 像素；落定时颗粒会长大并覆盖其单元。

description.en: Maximum distance in CSS pixels particles scatter from their home position.
description.zh: 粒子偏离原位的最大距离，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: Downward bias of the scattered cloud (-1 to 1), like sand settling. Negative values lift it.
description.zh: 散开粒子云的向下偏移（-1 至 1），如沙粒沉降；负值使其上浮。

description.en: Idle float speed of scattered particles (0 to 1). 0 freezes the cloud.
description.zh: 散开粒子的闲置浮动速度（0 至 1），0 冻结粒子云。

description.en: Sideways arc in CSS pixels particles take while flying home.
description.zh: 粒子飞回原位时的侧向弧线幅度，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: Per-particle randomness of reassembly timing (0 to 1).
description.zh: 各粒子重新聚合时序的随机程度（0 至 1）。

description.en: Opacity of fully scattered particles (0 to 1).
description.zh: 完全散开粒子的透明度（0 至 1）。

description.en: Seconds a row of dust takes to condense into the page once the reveal reaches it.
description.zh: 显现抵达后，一行尘埃凝聚为页面所需的秒数。

description.en: Seconds the damped scroll takes to catch up with the real scroll. Higher feels more fluid.
description.zh: 阻尼滚动追上真实滚动所需的秒数，值越高越有流动感。

description.en: Classes applied to the wrapper element.
description.zh: 应用到包装元素的 CSS 类。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
